item.title: MUNACA’s Campaign Exposes the McGill Administration’s Greed
item.dc:creator: The editorial team
item.description:
The McGill Daily · The editorial team · Oct 5 · 1:42 p.m.
According to the campaign website , salaries of MUNACA staff have increased by 6.1 per cent since the 2021-2022 fiscal year while those of the top 10 highest paid McGill positions have increased by 13.1 per cent. In 2024, MUNACA and McGill’s collective agreement expired; since then, MUNACA has been bargaining with McGill for fairer conditions and pay to no avail.

item.title: Health First!
item.dc:creator: The editorial team
item.description:
The McGill Daily · The editorial team · Oct 5 · 1:19 p.m.
Another result of neglecting nutrition is the normalization of skipping meals and underfueling. This issue is especially pertinent for young women, a major university demographic, who are the most prone to disordered eating. In addition to the destructive mental health consequences, the physical effects of restrictive eating are devastating: higher risk of death, osteoporosis, and low mobility.

item.title: Searching For a Third Space
item.dc:creator: The editorial team
item.description:
The McGill Daily · The editorial team · Oct 5 · 1:10 p.m.
As we spend September eating hot dogs on the Lower Field and strolling Montreal’s pedestrianized streets, we experience a city very different from the one it becomes in the winter. In November, when temperatures drop sharply and the first snow hits the ground the entire population retreats indoors. Bike paths become snowbanks, sidewalks narrow, and streets become deserted.

item.title: The Madonna-Whore Dichotomy: The Impossible Woman
item.dc:creator: Lyla Burt
item.description:
The McGill Daily · Lyla Burt · Oct 5 · 8:00 a.m.
Another instance of the complex in history is outlined in historian Anna Clark’s book titled, Desire: A History of European Sexuality where she discusses gender roles in Ancient Greece. Clark breaks down the views of Apollodorus, an ancient Greek writer and scholar. Apollodorus described women’s roles as divided by function: mistresses for pleasure, concubines for care, and wives for legitimacy.

item.dc:creator: Beau Milelli
item.description:
The McGill Daily · Beau Milelli · Oct 5 · 8:00 a.m.
If you’re looking for an under-the-radar classic, see Farrouj Express . A great pick for students living in New Residence and Metro shoppers alike, it’s fresh and unique in flavour (somehow sweet?). item.title: Les chroniqueurs polémistes : un mal nécessaire ?
item.dc:creator: Maxime Couture
item.description:
L'Exemplaire · Maxime Couture · 4 oct. · 18 h 54
Ce lundi 5 octobre, les Québécois iront voter afin de désigner les députés qui les représenteront à l’Assemblée nationale. D’ici là, les journalistes et les chroniqueurs informent la population sur les candidats et leurs programmes. Un travail essentiel. Sans mettre tous les chroniqueurs dans le même bateau, que faire lorsqu’ils dépassent les bornes et nuisent ainsi à la vie démocratique ?
item.content:encoded:
L'Exemplaire · Maxime Couture · 4 oct. · 18 h 54

Ce lundi 5 octobre, les Québécois iront voter afin de désigner les députés qui les représenteront à l’Assemblée nationale.
